Name: SimpleMute
Author: Anam Ahmed

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: One mute key. Detects the meeting running in your browser and mutes or unmutes your microphone. The key shows live state.

Actions.Name: Camera
Actions.Tooltip: Detects the meeting running in your browser and turns your camera on or off. The key shows live state.

Description: One mute key for every browser-based meeting. SimpleMute detects the meeting running in your browser and mutes or unmutes it, with keys that show live on/off state. Requires the SimpleMute browser extension.
